summary: Verified bulk series-assign bug fix: 6 fixture products under 'Ultra Tile' (including SERIES-TEST-6 with legacy Canopy-style long unique_name) all merge under a single 'Ultra Tile Cleaning & Maintenance Series' group after clicking the 'Set Series' floating pill. Backend pytest passes 2/2. Frontend E2E confirms all 6 rows in one group. Old 'Auto-Assign Series' toolbar button and SeriesAutoAssignModal.jsx are removed as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: SupplierProducts.js is 16777 lines — should be broken down into focused sub-modules (grouping, bulk-actions, filters, table row) for maintainability. Not a regression, but relevant for long-term health.
handleBulkSetSeries uses window.prompt (native browser dialog). Works, but a shadcn Dialog with validation (empty/whitespace/max length) would be a nicer UX consistent with the rest of admin.
React warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' fires in AdminDashboard render — pre-existing, unrelated to this fix, but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: Created 6 supplier_products SERIES-TEST-1..6 under supplier 'Ultra Tile' (SERIES-TEST-6 got Canopy-style long unique_name). All 6 deleted post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix validated end-to-end. Backend POST /api/admin/series/bulk-assign unconditionally overwrites series+range_name+unique_name (verified via DB read). GET /api/supplier-sync/products?supplier=Ultra%20Tile returns series, range_name and unique_name all matching the assigned value for all 6 SKUs. Frontend refresh after set-series merges all 6 into one 'Ultra Tile Cleaning & Maintenance Series' group header — screenshot confirms single group. `data-testid=open-series-assign-btn` does not exist in DOM. `data-testid=qa-set-series` pill is the sole entry point.
rca of the issue: Legacy Canopy imports stored full product name into supplier_products.unique_name. Frontend getSeriesName() previously preferred unique_name over series/range_name, so a bulk-set-series that only wrote 'series' left the Canopy row rendering under its own long-name group. Fix: (a) backend bulk-assign now overwrites unique_name too, (b) supplier-sync payload returns range_name, (c) frontend getSeriesName ignores unique_name when it looks like a full product name (>60 chars, contains ' - ', or has dimension tokens). Verified 6/6 rows collapsed into one group in UI.
